catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Setups and components: skills, MCP, hooks, subagents, plugins, and settings.
catalog.searchHelp: Use plain words or Catalog QL: NAME, TAGS, HARNESS, TYPE, AUTHOR and VERIFIED with :, AND, OR, NOT, IN, NOT IN and parentheses. Example: TYPE:skill AND HARNESS IN (codex, claude-code).
catalog.queryLiteralHint: Quotes search a reserved word as text: "AND".
catalog.experimentalNote: Main and experimental objects are shown together. Author verification is not proof that the contents are safe.
catalog.emptyAuthoritative: No main results for this query.
catalog.emptyAll: No catalog objects match this query.
catalog.tagFilterHelp: Limit results to objects tagged with any of the selected vocabulary tags.
catalog.updatedRangeHelp: Keep objects whose last catalog update falls in this inclusive date range.
catalog.harnessFilterHelp: Show objects whose passport names one of these harnesses. A component may name several.
catalog.typeFilterHelp: Keep only components of the selected kinds, such as skill or mcp.
catalog.authorFilterHelp: Match publisher account ids. Separate several with a comma.
catalog.verifiedOnlyHelp: Keep only objects whose author and component verification are both current.
catalog.countryFilterHelp: Keep objects linked to these markets. “Not specified” is objects with no country list.
catalog.serviceFilterHelp: Keep objects linked to these regional services. The list follows the selected countries.
catalog.filterHelpBody: Combine type, tags, author, and verification. The experimental filter applies to this search only.
catalog.compositionDescription: Exact components included in this setup.
catalog.authorVerifiedDescription: Author identity verified; this does not indicate content safety
catalog.reportSectionBody: Report this version from the CLI or the form below.
catalog.contextBudgetLead: Potential context this setup can add, not actual model usage.
catalog.contextBudgetComponentLead: Potential context from this component, not actual model usage:
catalog.contextBudgetRuntimeDerived: Runtime integration determines this component's context; package or source bytes would be a misleading estimate.
catalog.contextBudgetAlwaysHint: Included every time the setup loads.
catalog.contextBudgetConditionalHint: Added only when the agent uses that component.
catalog.contextBudgetEmpty: No tokenized components are visible in this setup.
catalog.contextBudgetError: The exact artifact is unavailable, so its context cannot be measured.
catalog.contextCostEmpty: Enter a rate to estimate cost. This is not actual usage.
catalog.contextCostInvalid: The rate must be a non-negative number.
catalog.contextCostHint: Calculated only in this browser. The rate is not saved and no pricing API is called.
catalog.localImpactCommandBody: Run this CLI command locally for baseline, delta and blast radius.
catalog.versionGapNote: Version numbers may be non-contiguous; missing numbers are intentional.
catalog.safetyCheckExplanation: Safety check: a set of automated checks that this component does not threaten the user's agent or device.
catalog.safetyIncomplete: Optional scanners were not run; the score uses finished checks
catalog.safetySummary: Automated checks reduce known risks; they do not guarantee that a component is safe.
catalog.safetyPayloadHidden: Finding content is hidden because it may contain secrets or malicious instructions.

structure.name: Passport structure
structure.description: Validates the passport schema and canonical form.

digest.name: Artifact integrity
digest.description: Recomputes the digest so changed bytes cannot pass as the published version.

license.name: License
license.description: Checks that redistribution terms are declared.

source_repo.name: Source provenance
source_repo.description: Confirms the exact public repository, commit and path.

artifact_unpack.name: Safe unpacking
artifact_unpack.description: Unpacks the artifact within size and file-count limits.

path_denylist.name: Dangerous paths
path_denylist.description: Rejects secrets, credentials, device files and unsafe paths.

secrets_heuristic.name: Secret patterns
secrets_heuristic.description: Looks for likely tokens, private keys and credentials.

secrets_gitleaks.name: Gitleaks secret scan
secrets_gitleaks.description: Runs the Gitleaks ruleset over the artifact.

content_hidden.name: Hidden content
content_hidden.description: Detects concealed instructions and suspicious invisible content.

pi_content_pack.name: Prompt injection
pi_content_pack.description: Looks for instructions that attempt to override the agent or exfiltrate data.

network_intent.name: Network intent
network_intent.description: Finds downloads piped to a shell and dangerous URL schemes, without DNS lookups.

agentic_behavior.name: Agentic behavior
agentic_behavior.description: Flags mechanically provable dangerous agent or skill declarations.

sast_opengrep.name: Static code analysis
sast_opengrep.description: Uses owned Opengrep rules to find unsafe code patterns.

mcp_config_static.name: MCP configuration
mcp_config_static.description: Validates MCP server maps, transports and dangerous capability chains.

hook_schema_static.name: Hook schema
hook_schema_static.description: Checks hook event, matcher and execution schema.

hook_command_argv.name: Hook commands
hook_command_argv.description: Requires hook execution as an argument array without unsafe substitution.

skill_static_gate.name: Agent skill policy
skill_static_gate.description: Checks skill metadata, permissions and malicious instruction patterns.

shell_obfuscation.name: Shell obfuscation
shell_obfuscation.description: Detects encoded or concatenated payloads that decode to a shell command.

sast_shellcheck.name: ShellCheck
sast_shellcheck.description: Runs ShellCheck on shell scripts in the artifact.

sast_bandit.name: Bandit
sast_bandit.description: Runs Bandit on Python sources outside test trees.

sca_pip_audit.name: pip-audit
sca_pip_audit.description: Audits pinned Python requirements offline when a lock file exists.

sca_govulncheck.name: govulncheck
sca_govulncheck.description: Checks Go modules for known vulnerabilities.

sca_cargo_audit.name: cargo-audit
sca_cargo_audit.description: Checks Rust crates for known vulnerabilities.

sca_cargo_deny.name: cargo-deny
sca_cargo_deny.description: Applies cargo-deny policy to Rust dependencies.

sast_eslint_security.name: ESLint security
sast_eslint_security.description: Runs eslint-plugin-security on JavaScript and TypeScript.

sca_npm_audit.name: npm audit
sca_npm_audit.description: Runs npm audit when a JavaScript manifest exists.

document_pdf.name: PDF document
document_pdf.description: Inspects PDF JavaScript, OpenAction and prompt-injection strings.

sca_osv.name: OSV Scanner
sca_osv.description: Looks up known vulnerabilities in an offline OSV database.

malware_clamav.name: ClamAV
malware_clamav.description: Scans binary content with ClamAV signatures.

malware_yara.name: YARA
malware_yara.description: Matches owned YARA rules against the artifact.

setup_pin_aggregate.name: Setup pins
setup_pin_aggregate.description: Joins exact component pins and their published check summaries.
